169. To the Sanctuary of the Arch-Enemy (5)
As the magic of the ice seal completed, the residual energy started to seep into Valeria at a faster pace.
Valeria quickly fell into a multitude of colorful bubbles, and the speed of her recovery was evident even to the naked eye.
Even after watching Valeria, who was gasping and slowly exhaling, Jin could not feel at ease.
There was a stone-like anxiety in his heart, worried about what would happen if her recovery suddenly stopped.
Veradin watched Jin with an intrigued expression.
'It seems the past me was indeed very close to Jin Runcandel. Judging by how I keep wanting to talk to him unnecessarily.'
From the moment his mind became clear, Veradin had become a cold person, unlike before.
He hadn't become cruel or horrifically heartless, but he had stopped feeling much for most things in the world.
Not just friendship, but familial love, caring for relatives - none of these remained.
All that was left for the current Veradin was a blind determination for Zipfel's resurgence.
Yet, strangely, he didn't mind talking to Jin.
No, beyond that, he even felt a sense of enjoyment.
"Jin Runcandel, I heard that you rarely show weakness no matter the situation."
"What are you trying to say?"
"Your face clearly shows that you are worried Hister might not recover. Could she be your lover?"
"She might have been."
"An odd answer. You broke up, didn't you?"
Jin didn't hear Veradin's next question as he was too focused on watching Valeria. Thankfully, her recovery was accelerating.
Veradin took out a glass bottle from his pocket and scooped up some of the colorful bubbles, unbothered by Jin's silence.
The bubbles in the bottle gave off a beautiful opalescent light.
It was unknown what kind of reward this trace of magic would bring to Zipfel.
But whatever the price, it wasn't more important than Valeria's life to Jin and the Vamel alliance.
Finally, Valeria opened her eyes and took a deep breath.
Without thinking, Jin pulled her into his arms.
He almost shouted her name.
"Jin... Jin Runcandel?"
"Yeah, it's me."
"How... ugh."
"Your wound hasn't fully healed yet. It's okay to wait and talk slowly."
Valeria looked down at her chest.
As she remembered the moment she was pierced by Luntia's sword, pain momentarily revisited her.
Memory.
With a sensation as if her head was about to burst, the memories of the moment she fell were flooding back like a tidal wave.
"Nero... How is Lord Nero!?"
"He's safe. Nero was protecting you."
"Thank goodness...."
Valeria's gaze met Veradin's.
She saw the traces of her magic being contained in the glass bottle he was holding.
She had just awoken and was disoriented, but Valeria soon regained her usual cool demeanor.
"Jin, the recovery is complete. We better leave this place now."
She knew that the power of this land, known as Zipfel's sanctuary, had healed her.
She had seen records about the sanctuary from the most recently visited legacy site of Hister.
The records weren't detailed. They just mentioned that the sanctuary could heal complete magic bodies.
Therefore, from the moment Valeria first sealed herself, she had hoped that Jin and his comrades would save her and bring her here.
She felt that Jin, if not anyone else, could do it somehow, and her intuition was spot on.
'King of Demons Orgal, Jin must have obtained information about this place from him. He was the one who informed my ancestors about this place.'
Valeria was unaware of the situation during that time.
She didn't know there had been a great battle in the Garden of Swords, nor did she know that the three major forces had formed a temporary alliance, or that Jin was Rosa's only counterpart.
'It seems the three forces also found out about the power of the Garden of Swords. So they formed a temporary alliance, and Zipfel opened the sanctuary...'
Nonetheless, Valeria quickly deduced the entire situation.
"Let's do that."
There was a lot to discuss once they left. Jin also didn't want to stay in the sanctuary for a second longer now that Valeria had recovered.
More importantly, the residual energy of the sanctuary had only perfectly healed Valeria's wound.
The chaotic energy left in the wound of Amun had not been purified, so they had to return to Tikan and use a purification device.
"Before we leave, I have one more request, Jin Runcandel."
At the sudden words, Jin met Veradin's gaze with a calm eye.
"I didn't know you had a knack for quickly breaking trust, Veradin Zipfel. Do you plan on threatening me after the deal is done?"
"You are making a fuss even though you know what I will ask for."
"If it's for the treatment of Hwaryong Kadun, I will accept it."
Hwaryong Kadun.
He was massively exposed to chaos due to the first full-scale attack on the Garden of Swords and the Calderan Snowfield battle.
Jin had anticipated that Zipfel would demand his treatment from the time of the Sanctuary opening negotiations.
"Alright. When we go to Tikan, we should bring Lord Kadun with us."
"Understood."
The path out of the sanctuary was the same as when they first arrived.
If you turn back the way you came, the boundary will gradually deepen into a landscape of hospitality.
They passed through the hallway, the entrance to the sanctuary, and a door appeared.
And beyond the door, unlike when they first entered the sanctuary, many people were waiting.
Many magicians in white robes, holding swords.
'Biological golems...!'
No, they were modified humans, possibly a form of magic swordsmen.
The number was so large that even if you looked far away, there was no end in sight.
"You're blatantly advertising to me the fact that you're cultivating biological golems of the magic swordsman. Are you trying to scare me now?"
Unlike Veradin, each of them emitted a considerable magic power and aura.
If their combat skills were on par with that, even Jin couldn't guarantee he could handle all of them.
Especially if he had to fight while protecting Valeria.
'They're not just dolls with energy. They're completely different from the untrained ones, even their breathing.'
Another strange point was that their body sizes were all exactly the same. Just like the Prophet cloned Joshua.
When Jin approached the nearest biological golem and tried to take off its hood, Veradin blocked his hand.
"Look only at what we have agreed to show, Jin Runcandel."
"I have a hunch that the face under that hood is going to look exactly like you."
"Do I have such a common face? There's plenty of content in my dwindling diary saying that I'm too handsome."
"I don't know what you're up to. It was strange from the beginning that you didn't hide the fact that you were becoming a magic swordsman."
"I hope you understand that it's a matter of sharing forces from the standpoint of having a common enemy."
With such a large number of magic swordsman biological golems, they could certainly have played a significant role in the first total attack on the Garden of Swords.
However, the biological golems sent from Zipfel's fleet at that time were of a much inferior level compared to these, and were enhanced entities through 'chaos control'.
The same was true for the biological golems who died in Calderan Snowfield.
Jin could intuitively figure out the reason.
"......These biological golems seem to be able to exert their power only near the sanctuary."
The reason why there were no magic swordsman biological golems at the time of the total attack was only that.
With Kadun and Octavia directly participating, Zipfel had almost all of his 'deployable' forces at the time.
Veradin nodded as if there was no need to hide it.

"That's right. We're looking for a way to send them outside the sanctuary. As of now, they stop functioning like dolls with cut strings as soon as they leave the vicinity of the sanctuary. Meaning they die. Besides, I don't understand why you're uncomfortable. Do you think being a magic swordsman is a privilege only for your family?"
Jin shook his head.
"No, it's because I'm friends with you."
Jin spoke as if there was nothing to hide.
"I see."
Veradin said as he moved.
"But, you should have spoken in the past tense. There is no chance that we will be close again."
As Jin and Valeria followed him, all the biological golems mechanically followed their gaze.
The number of biological golems did not decrease while they walked for a long time outside the sanctuary.
Eventually, Jin arrived at the area where he first arrived, and Ronil was waiting for them with Kojek on standby as he did when he came.
The biological golems disappeared only then.
As soon as he saw Jin returning, Ronil checked his pocket watch and showed surprise.
"How much time has passed? Brother Ronil."
"......A day. Only a day has passed."
"The sanctuary was very hospitable to Hister. Maybe...... it might have been hospitable to Jin Runcandel."
"Your father is looking for you."
"I was going to see him right away. He would be curious about this."
While showing a glass bottle to Ronil, Veradin turned around and reached out to Jin.
Jin looked at his hand for a few seconds before shaking it.
"Goodbye, Jin Runcandel. With this, I have kept the promise I made before losing my memory."
Wait for me, Veradin.
Jin did not say that out loud and let go of the handshake.
"I will escort you to Tikan, Lord Jin."
"I understand, Ronil Zipfel."
Back in a cabin without a window, Jin and Valeria sat facing each other and shared the stories of the time they had spent.
Valeria said thank you many times, and Jin found it very strange yet pleasant to see her like that in his current life.
"......As expected, they formed a temporary alliance. It was an inevitable choice to confront the Garden of Swords. Then, there's one thing I have to tell them before we get off the ship."
"Something to tell Zipfel?"
"The royal family betrayed Zipfel. And maybe, your friend. The Lord of the Sword Emperor might be in danger."
